title: Richard Dedekind: Source-Witnessed Working Drafts and English Translations
description:
Dedicated Richard Dedekind author record for source-witnessed working drafts and English translations. Current reader surface includes the collected Gesammelte mathematische Werke PDFs, the German/English working draft of Was sind und was sollen die Zahlen?, the early Stetigkeit und irrationale Zahlen segment, Dedekind/Dirichlet paratext items LII-LIX, and a source-witnessed German/English cumulative layer for GMW Volume I Items I-IV plus Item V through Article 13.

Latest update. DR17 adds paired German and English cumulative readers including Item V, Abriß einer Theorie der höheren Kongruenzen in bezug auf einen reellen Primzahl-Modulus, through Article 13 on printed pp. 40-55. The source packet includes TeX, component PDFs, and the printed pp. 40-55 source scan slice. Continuation begins with Item V, Article 14, on printed p. 55.

Status at a glance. This is a source-witnessed working-draft record, not a certified critical edition, not whole-author completion, and not mathematical certification. Source witnesses and package ledgers should be used to verify citation-critical formulas, references, typography, and notation.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Metadata-only caveat refresh on the DR17 public surface. Current public files represent GMW Volume I Items I-IV plus Item V through Article 13 as source-witnessed working drafts. The latest source packet includes printed pp.40-55 source scan slice; next continuation follows with Item V, Article 14, on printed p.55. Not a certified critical edition, not whole-author completion, and not mathematical certification.
